text_block_list.text: One day, while training with Mejiro Dober—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Mejiro Dober-san!
So this is where you were!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna-san?
What in the world happened?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I've come bearing great news!
In recognition of Mejiro Dober-san's
outstanding performance during the Classic year—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The URA has decided to award
Mejiro Dober the title of
"Best Classic Queen Umamusume"!

"Best Queen Umamusume" is a title awarded to Umamusume
who excelled in races like the Hanshin JF,
the Triple Tiara, and the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

Slots have been established for the Junior, Classic, and Senior stages,
which means this time Mejiro Dober will be selected for the Classic Class...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"The Classic Year's...
Best Queen Umamusume...!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy...!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations♪
The award ceremony will be held at a later date,
so it might be a good idea to prepare your comments in advance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. After training,
you're going to help me practice my interview comments, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. After training,
could you help me practice my interview comments?
And then came the day of the award ceremony—
And then came the day of the award ceremony—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us hear a few words from
the recipient of the Best Classic-Class Queen Umamusume,
Mejiro Dober-san.
(Clap clap clap clap clap—)

Amid the thunderous applause and flashing cameras,
Mejiro Dober stands dignified...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...Thank you so very much for selecting me for such a wonderful award."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I will continue to run in a manner worthy of this award—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best so that I can stand on this podium
in the Senior Year as well.

At Mejiro Dober's words,
the venue was once again filled with applause and cheers of admiration!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's a bit late to say it now, but
maybe I talked a little too big back there...
choice_data_list: You looked really cool, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I-I wasn't trying to act cool, I swear!
I was just making my intentions clear, that's all..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-What do you mean, cool...!!
I was just stating my determination, that's all...
Jeez.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I fully intend to follow through on my word...
So you better be ready for it too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've said it,
we've gotta stick to our word and see it through, right?
Yeah... let's do our best, Trainer.

And so, the award ceremony concluded safely,
in a way that truly showed how much
Mejiro Dober had grown...!

Mejiro Dober had grown...!
